fun_facts: Seth McGowan is from Mesquite, Texas, and attended Poteet High School.
In 2024, Seth McGowan rushed for 823 yards at New Mexico State, averaging 5.4 yards per carry.
At Kentucky in 2025, Seth McGowan scored 12 rushing touchdowns—one of just four players in the SEC to reach that total.
Seth McGowan rushed for 104 yards and three touchdowns in Kentucky’s 2025 win over Eastern Michigan.
Seth McGowan has had an NFL game with career highs of 12 carries and 77 rushing yards.
